segments.caption: A calm companion for daily remembrance
segments.narration: For many Muslims, faith includes a quiet daily rhythm — repeating short prayers that remember God, often counted on prayer beads. Misbaha helps them stay consistent: counting each phrase, following plans, and tracking progress.

segments.caption: Your spiritual dashboard at a glance
segments.narration: Today shows daily counts, lifetime totals, active goals, and hourly activity.

segments.caption: Browse prayers by category
segments.narration: The Counter organizes prayers by category — scripture, morning and evening, worship, and hardship.

segments.caption: Find any prayer instantly
segments.narration: Search by English spelling or Arabic script — on the Counter screen or inside Goals.

segments.caption: Search while building a goal
segments.narration: The same search works when planning goals — pick prayers and drop them into your plan.

segments.caption: Count toward your daily target
segments.narration: Open any prayer for text, translation, and references. Double-tap to count, hold to complete.

segments.caption: Gentle plans for steady progress
segments.narration: Goals turn remembrance into plans — suggested paths, surprise challenges, or custom rotations.

segments.caption: One focused prayer each day
segments.narration: Each goal focuses one prayer per day with progress tracking and a quick counter.

segments.caption: Build your own spiritual roadmap
segments.narration: Plan a new goal by choosing prayers and duration.

segments.caption: Three visual journeys through your progress
segments.narration: Visualize three ways — a growing garden, a walk across the earth, or a rise into the stars.

segments.caption: Badges reward consistency and exploration
segments.narration: Earn badges as you count — finish prayer cycles, keep streaks, complete goals, and try new prayers. Each milestone unlocks the next set of ten.

segments.caption: Personalize the counting experience
segments.narration: Tune counts per tap, themes, language, sound, and haptics.

segments.caption: Misbaha by Zikr Apps
segments.narration: Misbaha — counting, goals, and visual journeys. From Zikr Apps.
